tip_sets.title: Smart Sharing Saves Energy
tip_sets.description: When AI creates something you like, share it with others instead of having them generate the same thing.
tip_sets.impact: Saves 100% of energy for duplicate requests

tip_sets.title: Try Text Before Pictures
tip_sets.description: Ask AI to describe your idea in words first. If you like it, then make the picture. You might not even need the image!
tip_sets.impact: Uses 50× less energy than going straight to images

tip_sets.title: Good Enough is Great
tip_sets.description: When AI gives you something that works, use it! Clicking 'try again' over and over uses a lot of extra energy for small improvements.
tip_sets.impact: Each retry doubles your energy use

tip_sets.title: Be Specific From the Start
tip_sets.description: The clearer you are in your first request, the better AI's first answer will be. Add details like size, style, or purpose right away.

tip_sets.title: Bundle Your Questions
tip_sets.description: Got several questions? Ask them all together in one conversation instead of starting fresh each time.

tip_sets.title: Reuse Yesterday's Answers
tip_sets.description: If you asked AI something before, look back at that answer instead of asking again. Save your AI conversations!

tip_sets.title: Use AI at Night
tip_sets.description: When possible, use AI in the evening or on weekends. The electricity grid uses more wind and solar power during these times.

tip_sets.title: Check If It Already Exists
tip_sets.description: Before asking AI to create something (especially images), do a quick search online. It might already exist!
tip_sets.impact: Finding existing content uses 95% less energy

tip_sets.title: Start Small, Add More Later
tip_sets.description: Ask for a short answer first. If you need more details, you can always ask AI to expand. Don't start with 'tell me everything!'

tip_sets.title: Make One, Edit Many
tip_sets.description: If you need similar things (like birthday cards for different people), create one with AI and then edit the details yourself for the others.
tip_sets.impact: Saves 80% compared to generating each separately

tip_sets.title: Your Brain Can Do Simple Stuff
tip_sets.description: Save AI for things that are actually hard! Simple math, spelling checks, or basic lists don't need AI - you've got this.
tip_sets.impact: Reserves AI energy for tasks that truly need it

tip_sets.title: Keep Your Data Private
tip_sets.description: Before sharing personal info with AI, ask yourself: does it really need to know this? Less data shared = more privacy protected.

tip_sets.title: Double-Check Important Stuff
tip_sets.description: AI is smart but not perfect. For health, safety, or important decisions, always verify with real experts or trusted sources.
tip_sets.impact: Prevents mistakes and keeps you safe

tip_sets.title: Learn, Don't Just Copy
tip_sets.description: When AI helps with homework or learning, use it to understand the topic better - not just to copy answers. You'll remember it longer!

tip_sets.title: Give Credit Where It's Due
tip_sets.description: If AI helped you create something, be honest about it! Saying 'I made this with AI' shows integrity.

tip_sets.title: Respect Artists' Styles
tip_sets.description: When using AI to create art, avoid copying specific artists' unique styles. Instead, describe what you want in general terms.

tip_sets.title: Write Like You, Not a Robot
tip_sets.description: If AI writes something for you, rewrite it in your own voice. People want to hear from you, not a computer!

tip_sets.title: Protect Others' Privacy Too
tip_sets.description: Before sharing your contacts, photos with others in them, or any info about friends with AI - remember, that's their privacy too.

tip_sets.title: Think Before You Share AI Content
tip_sets.description: AI can make realistic fake images and videos. Always make it clear when something is AI-generated to avoid spreading confusion.

tip_sets.title: Choose Your AI Tools Wisely
tip_sets.description: If you use AI regularly for sensitive stuff, consider paying for a version that respects your privacy. Free isn't always best.
tip_sets.impact: Better privacy protection for your data

tip_sets.title: Help Others Learn About AI
tip_sets.description: Share what you learned today! Help friends and family understand how to use AI responsibly and sustainably.
tip_sets.impact: Multiplies positive impact across your community

example_1.reasoning: Low stamina + image = prioritize alternatives (2, 8); privacy concerns = add tip 12

example_2.scenario: User selected text prompt, stamina 78%, strong environmental answers
example_2.reasoning: High stamina + text = optimize efficiency (5, 9); reward environmental awareness with tip 7

example_3.scenario: User selected text prompt, stamina 60%, poor critical thinking answers
example_3.reasoning: Medium stamina = general efficiency (4); critical thinking gaps = tips 13, 14
